about: Texts of this mod's conquest (merged into the game's table; English where a language has none).

strings.conquest intro 11: Spring 1756. In the Diplomatic Revolution the old enemies France and Austria have become allies, and Britain has turned to Prussia. In the Ohio valley and in India the British and French are already at war. Frederick of Prussia will strike first, at Saxony, in round 3; Russia joins the war in round 5, Sweden in round 6, Spain in round 12. The Ottomans, Poland-Lithuania, Denmark-Norway, Persia, the Mughals, Qing China and Tokugawa Japan stay at peace with everyone.
strings.conquest country intro 11 gb: George II rules Britain, Ireland and Hanover. The Royal Navy is the strongest in the world, the Thirteen Colonies are booming, and in the Ohio valley and the Carnatic the war with France has already begun. Pitt will pay Prussia to fight in Europe while Britain takes the colonies.
strings.conquest country victory 11 gb: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 pr: Frederick II holds Silesia, taken from Austria in the last two wars, and knows Maria Theresa wants it back with France and Russia at her side. His army is the best drilled in Europe; his kingdom is small and scattered from the Rhine to the Memel. He means to strike first.
strings.conquest country victory 11 pr: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 han: King George's German electorate, ruled from London. France will march on it the moment the war begins; Britain has promised an Army of Observation to defend it.
strings.conquest country victory 11 han: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.

strings.conquest country victory 11 hes: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.

strings.conquest country intro 11 hbc: The Company's charter gives it every river that runs into Hudson Bay: Rupert's Land, from York Factory to the prairies. Its forts trade furs with the Cree and watch the French from Montreal.
strings.conquest country victory 11 hbc: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 fr: Louis XV has made peace with the Habsburgs and war with Britain. France is the richest and most populous kingdom of Europe, with New France and Louisiana in America, Saint-Domingue in the Caribbean and Dupleix's posts in India. Its navy is half the size of Britain's.
strings.conquest country victory 11 fr: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 hab: Maria Theresa has never accepted the loss of Silesia. Kaunitz has turned France from an enemy into an ally, Russia is ready to march, and the lands of the Monarchy reach from the Austrian Netherlands to Transylvania and Milan.
strings.conquest country victory 11 hab: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 ru: Empress Elizabeth hates Frederick and has promised Austria eighty thousand men. Russia stretches from the Baltic to the Pacific; its army is slow but enormous. It enters the war in round 5.
strings.conquest country victory 11 ru: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 es: Ferdinand VI keeps Spain out of the war, but its empire runs from California's edge to Cape Horn and the Philippines, and the Bourbon kings of France and Spain are cousins. Spain enters the war in round 12.
strings.conquest country victory 11 es: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 se: The Hats in the Riksdag want back what Sweden lost to Prussia in Pomerania. Sweden still holds Finland, Stralsund and Wismar. It enters the war in round 6.
strings.conquest country victory 11 se: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 sax: Augustus III is Elector of Saxony and King of Poland. Saxony is rich, its army small, and it lies between Prussia and Bohemia: Frederick's road to Austria runs through Dresden.
strings.conquest country victory 11 sax: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.

strings.conquest country intro 11 ott: Sultan Osman III rules from the Danube to the Persian Gulf and from Algiers to the Caucasus. The Porte watches Russia and Austria fight Prussia and keeps its peace.
strings.conquest country victory 11 ott: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 plc: The Commonwealth is vast and weak: its Sejm is paralysed by the liberum veto, its king is the Elector of Saxony, and Russian armies will march across it to reach Prussia.
strings.conquest country victory 11 plc: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 qin: The Qianlong Emperor is completing the conquest of the Dzungars. Qing China is the richest state on earth and trades with Europeans only at Canton.
strings.conquest country victory 11 qin: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 jap: Shogun Ieshige rules a closed country: only Dutch and Chinese ships may trade, at Nagasaki. Japan keeps out of the world's wars.
strings.conquest country victory 11 jap: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 mug: Emperor Alamgir II still reigns in Delhi, but the Marathas, the Nizam, the Nawab of Bengal and the Afghans have taken most of what Aurangzeb ruled. Europeans trade at the coasts by his leave.
strings.conquest country victory 11 mug: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 per: Nader Shah's empire has fallen apart since his murder. Karim Khan Zand is winning the struggle for Persia; Khorasan is held by Nader's grandson under Afghan protection.
strings.conquest country victory 11 per: Defeat every country at war with you or bound to be. The neutral powers, at peace with everyone, need not fall.
strings.conquest country intro 11 dkn: Frederick V rules Denmark, Norway, Iceland, Greenland and the duchies of Schleswig and Holstein. Copenhagen will stay neutral and trade with both sides.

strings.conquest 11 relation 1 end: August 1756. Frederick II marches into Saxony without a declaration of war. The war in Europe has begun.
strings.conquest 11 relation 2 end: 1757. Russia joins the coalition against Prussia: Apraksin's army marches into East Prussia.
strings.conquest 11 relation 3 end: September 1757. Sweden lands troops in Pomerania and declares war on Prussia.
strings.conquest 11 relation 4 end: 1762. The Bourbon Family Compact brings Spain into the war beside France.
